nodes.label: Demo mode payment simulator
nodes.rationale: Shown only when payments_mode is mock; no real money moves.

nodes.label: WhatsApp floating icon (showWhatsApp)
nodes.rationale: Shown only when config.whatsapp is set.

nodes.label: D1 migrations 0012_gear.sql, 0013_whatsapp.sql
nodes.rationale: Must be applied first via wrangler d1 execute.

nodes.label: Not built: checkout inside WhatsApp
nodes.rationale: Bot currently sends customers to the website to order.

nodes.label: WhatsApp bot commands (MENU, ORDER, DELIVERY, HOURS, PAY, STATUS, HUMAN)
nodes.norm_label: whatsapp bot commands (menu, order, delivery, hours, pay, status, human)
nodes.rationale: Customers get messages on WhatsApp with SMS fallback; riders and owner alerts stay on SMS.

nodes.label: WhatsApp Meta Cloud API go-live steps
nodes.norm_label: whatsapp meta cloud api go-live steps
nodes.rationale: Utility template order_update with body {{1}} needed for messages outside the 24-hour window; WA_ALLOWLIST while testing; WHATSAPP_NUMBER also shows the shop icon.

nodes.label: GO_LIVE.md (M-Pesa and WhatsApp go-live)
nodes.rationale: Both integrations tested only in demo/mock mode; need real provider accounts.

nodes.label: hookahArt()
nodes.rationale: Procedural SVG of a modern black hookah with crystal vase in three sizes (small, medium, large); item colour on coals, ring and glass.

nodes.label: packArt()
nodes.rationale: Stand-in product art until real photos; f.image overrides; branches by size: night (hookah), sample (cone), gear, default packet pouch.

nodes.label: Fonts: Unbounded, Inter, Great Vibes
nodes.rationale: Self-hosted in public/vendor/fonts; Unbounded for labels/buttons, Inter body, Great Vibes script for flavour names and titles.

nodes.label: Comic product art language
nodes.rationale: Placeholder until real photos (f.image overrides). Thick ink outlines, cel shading, halftone, highlight streaks, offset layer, flat ground shadow. No SVG noise filters (caused lag); depth dimming uses --sd overlay not CSS filters; do not use --dim (colour token).

nodes.label: Strict CSP on server pages
nodes.rationale: Delivery and rider pages may load only /theme.css and self-hosted fonts.

nodes.label: DESIGN.md (design lock)
nodes.rationale: Locked 2026-11-01; change only on the owner's explicit request.

nodes.label: index.html (shop front end)
nodes.rationale: Single-page shop: dark stage, flavour record rails, detail view, order dialog, payment progress.

nodes.label: No cannabis logos or wording rule
nodes.norm_label: no cannabis logos or wording rule
nodes.rationale: Cannabis-leaf logos and cannabis wording stay out of art and copy.

nodes.label: /api/mpesa/callback/<CALLBACK_SECRET>
nodes.rationale: Secret as last URL part authenticates Safaricom callback.

nodes.label: stage() and progress() order tracker
nodes.rationale: Five steps: Awaiting payment, Payment confirmed, Awaiting rider, Rider en route, Completed; flags red when no riders or rider wait exceeds 2 minutes.

nodes.label: Checkout flow (confirm number, POST order, poll)
nodes.norm_label: checkout flow (confirm number, post order, poll)
nodes.rationale: Confirms the number before sending a payment prompt to prevent prompting the wrong phone; polls every 2s.

nodes.label: renderProg() progress steps
nodes.rationale: Four steps: placing order, prompt sent, payment confirmed, rider assigned; shows slow-rider message after 2 minutes.

nodes.label: resolvePhone()
nodes.rationale: Mirrors server rules: leading 0 dropped; 07/01/254/+254 accepted; Kenyan numbers only.

nodes.label: M-Pesa Daraja go-live steps
nodes.rationale: Till/Buy Goods; secrets DARAJA_KEY/SECRET/PASSKEY/SHORTCODE/TILL and CALLBACK_SECRET; PAYMENTS_MODE=daraja, DARAJA_ENV production (sandbox first).

nodes.label: 5-minute unpaid-order reconciliation job
nodes.rationale: Safaricom status query returns no receipt, so such orders show no receipt; check M-Pesa statement.

nodes.label: Data collected: phone, delivery spot, order, IP
nodes.norm_label: data collected: phone, delivery spot, order, ip
nodes.rationale: IP kept only to stop abuse; PINs are never seen by the shop.

nodes.label: buildRows() and SIZE_ROWS
nodes.rationale: Rows: sample (Samples), packet (Packets), night (Hookah rental, per night), gear; a row appears only if a flavour has that size.

nodes.label: Order total and quote (items + delivery fee)
nodes.norm_label: order total and quote (items + delivery fee)
nodes.rationale: updateTotal, deliveryFee and refreshQuote compute total = price x qty + delivery fee; fallback fee from config.pricing.

nodes.label: openDetail / closeDetail / swapDetail
nodes.rationale: Cloned pack grows to about half the screen while a circular colour cover reveals.

nodes.label: makeRail()
nodes.rationale: Builds a rail row keyed by size with swipe, wipe background, arrows and tap-to-open.

nodes.label: openOrder()
nodes.rationale: For night items the quantity label becomes Nights.

nodes.label: switchBg() background colour wipe
nodes.rationale: Colour switches in direction of travel; skipped under reduced motion.

nodes.label: Record rail shop home
nodes.rationale: Swipe flips one record at a time; background colour switches on swipe; vertical scroll moves between rows; tap front record opens detail.

nodes.label: GET /api/admin/payments/check
nodes.rationale: Must show missing: [], oauth ok, ready true.

nodes.label: Whole-site dark system (tokens, fonts)
nodes.rationale: bg #050505, white ink, dim #a6a6a6; flavour colour only for background wipe and product art; one filled white pill per screen; bare chevron arrows.

nodes.label: Unfilled placeholders (business name, retention, contact, date)
nodes.norm_label: unfilled placeholders (business name, retention, contact, date)
nodes.rationale: Must be completed before go-live.

nodes.label: theme.css shared tokens
nodes.rationale: Shared dark tokens for non-shop pages.

nodes.label: admin.html (owner admin page)
nodes.rationale: noindex; bearer admin token kept in sessionStorage; auto-refreshes every 15s unless editing.

nodes.label: privacy.html (privacy notice)
nodes.rationale: Under Kenya's Data Protection Act 2019; contains TODO placeholders for business name, retention period, contact, date.

nodes.label: Map pin (Leaflet, geolocation)
nodes.rationale: Delivery area enforced client-side (config.area) and by quote max_km; map failure falls back to typed landmark.

nodes.label: SMS log (Africa's Talking)
nodes.rationale: 'sent' means Africa's Talking accepted it; anything else needs a look.

nodes.label: Third parties: Safaricom, Airtel, Africa's Talking, Cloudflare, OpenStreetMap
nodes.norm_label: third parties: safaricom, airtel, africa's talking, cloudflare, openstreetmap
nodes.rationale: No selling, advertising, tracking cookies or analytics.

nodes.label: /api/admin/orders/:id/cancel|reassign
nodes.rationale: Cancel requires manual refund to customer.

nodes.label: load()
nodes.rationale: Fetches orders, riders, sms, blocked, monitor, shop, menu in parallel; 403 logs out.

nodes.label: monitorTile() outside monitor
nodes.rationale: Needs MONITOR_TOKEN; live if reported within 15 min.

nodes.label: renderMenu() and menu editor
nodes.rationale: Changes apply to new orders immediately; placed orders keep charged price; hidden flavours stay in admin.

nodes.label: shopTile() open/close control
nodes.rationale: Shop hours 8:00 am to midnight; manual close available.

nodes.label: down() orders paused screen and closed bar
nodes.norm_label: down() orders paused screen and closed bar
nodes.rationale: Shown if health or flavors fail; config re-polled every 5 minutes for shop open state.

nodes.label: Blocked numbers list
nodes.rationale: Number matched in any format; blocked numbers cannot order.

nodes.label: Rider management (add, suspend, link, settle)
nodes.rationale: Each rider has a private link page; New link invalidates the old; rider mode is a demo (all paid orders go to rider #1).
